description: Pectoralis major and minor; push the arms forward and across the body, as in presses and push-ups.
Latissimus dorsi, trapezius and rhomboids; pull the arms down and back and keep the shoulder blades stable.
Deltoids (front, side and rear); raise the arms forward, sideways and back and press overhead.
Biceps brachii and brachialis; bend the elbow and turn the forearm palm up.
Triceps brachii; straighten the elbow, as in dips, close-grip presses and pushdowns.
Four muscles at the front of the thigh; straighten the knee, as in squats, lunges and leg extensions.
Three muscles at the back of the thigh; bend the knee and extend the hip, as in leg curls and Romanian deadlifts.
Gluteus maximus, medius and minimus; extend and stabilise the hip, as in hip thrusts, bridges and squats.
Gastrocnemius and soleus; point the foot down, as in calf raises, and absorb landing in running and jumping.
Abdominals, obliques and deep trunk muscles; brace and stabilise the spine and resist bending and rotation.
